Key takeaways for leadership

  • Hyper-growth confirmed. MRR up 1143.62% in 30 months, active subscribers up 419% — every region and plan is contributing.
  • Enterprise is the revenue engine. Highest ARPU, highest NRR (consistently > 1.10), strongest NPS — double down here.
  • Retention is healthy. Average NRR of 107.9% means existing customers expand faster than they churn; logo churn rate is 2.77%.
  • Scale is creating support load. Support tickets correlate strongly with active subscribers — staff support and self-serve content ahead of the curve.
  • Marketing efficiency is uneven. Spend → new-sub correlation is weak; rebalance budget toward higher-yield region/plan combinations.
